title: Appeals and Grievances Training Sheet: Other Health Insurance on an Inpatient Line Under Allowable Charge Review
content:
Appeals and Grievances — questions on the other insurer's payment counted on the line under review

Scope: an Allowable Charge Review opened on a paid TRICARE Select inpatient line.

Rule: The other insurer's payment counted on the line under review is taken as follows: where other health insurance is on file for the patient and the line under review itself shows the other insurer's payment, that payment is counted; where other health insurance is on file, the line under review shows no such payment and an earlier posting of the same service date on the same claim shows one, the largest payment shown on the claim's postings of that service date is counted; in every other case no payment by another insurer is counted.

Records read: whether the patient's active TRICARE Select enrollment shows other health insurance on file; the amount other health insurance paid first as shown on the line under review's own TRICARE Select record (a payment is shown when that amount is above zero); and the same amount on the claim's other postings with the same service date.

*Other health insurance is on file and the line under review shows a payment of 60.00 by the other insurer (hypothetical). What is counted?* 60.00, the payment on the line itself.

*Other health insurance is on file, the line under review shows nothing, and earlier postings of the same service date show 35.00 and 52.40.* 52.40, the largest payment shown on the claim's postings of that service date.

*The line under review shows a payment of 60.00 but no other health insurance is on file for the patient.* Nothing is counted.

| Other health insurance on file | Payment shown on the line | Payment shown on an earlier posting of that service date | Payment counted |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | any | the payment shown on the line |
| yes | no | yes | the largest payment shown on the claim's postings of that service date |
| yes | no | no | none (0.00) |
| no | any | any | none (0.00) |
